nodes.name: Every 6h
nodes.notes: ADR-054 Block 3 (upgraded 2026-07-02): REAL tool-connectivity dead-man's-switch for the hosted ClickUp MCP (mcp.clickup.com/mcp) that the tier agents use for caller-scoped discovery. Prior version only GET-pinged the PUBLIC OAuth well-known URL — which returns 2xx even when the harness cannot actually connect the MCP + inject a per-user token (exactly the 2026-07-01 silent failure: tools denied, well-known still 200). This now opens a real minimal probe session (cheap Haiku agent + Franciszek's ClickUp vault) and calls clickup_get_workspace_hierarchy in-harness — the same path a real task uses — so a genuine connection failure is caught within ~6h instead of at the next real task.

nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Test entry for Definition-of-Done verification via scripts/test-subworkflow.mjs (a Schedule Trigger cannot be fired over the n8n API). No inputs needed.

nodes.name: Fetch Probe Inputs
nodes.notes: One row of probe prerequisites: the managed Anthropic key (get_anthropic_key(), migration 034), the cheapest tier agent (Haiku — the clickup MCP is registered on every tier agent, so the model is irrelevant to connectivity but Haiku minimises probe cost), the persistent environment id (config.managed_agent_environment_id), and Franciszek's active per-user ClickUp Vault id (a stable, always-onboarded probe identity; user_data_and_config). A missing prerequisite -> Run ClickUp Probe throws -> CRITICAL (we cannot even probe). Read-only.

nodes.name: Run ClickUp Probe
nodes.notes: Opens a REAL managed session (agent + environment + Franciszek's ClickUp vault) and asks the agent to call ONLY clickup_get_workspace_hierarchy, then polls the session events up to ~48s. HEALTHY = the call ran in-harness (agent.mcp_tool_use name clickup_*), i.e. the MCP connected + the vault token authed. FAILURE (throw -> CRITICAL via onError=continueErrorOutput) = the harness DENIED the call (agent.tool_result 'Permission to use clickup_* has been denied'), OR routed clickup_* as an unserviced client custom tool (agent.custom_tool_use — the exact 2026-07-01 shape when the MCP did not connect), OR a clickup mcp_authentication/ session error surfaced. INCONCLUSIVE (agent never attempted the tool within budget — a steering miss, not an outage) -> healthy path, no alarm, to avoid false CRITICALs. Best-effort DELETEs the probe session at the end. Uses this.helpers.httpRequest (allowed in Code nodes on this instance; crypto/$env are not, but none are needed here — the key arrives in item data).

nodes.name: Healthy
nodes.notes: Terminal for the healthy (or inconclusive-no-alarm) path. Silent on purpose — a healthy probe must NOT post to the Alerts task every 6h.

nodes.name: Alert ClickUp MCP Down
nodes.notes: CRITICAL via Post Alert (v1) seam (ADR-025) when the REAL probe could not connect the ClickUp MCP / inject the per-user token (tools denied, routed as client custom tool, or a session/auth error) OR a probe prerequisite was missing. While this fails, tier agents lose caller-scoped ClickUp discovery/doc reading -> deliverables silently degrade. Check status.clickup.com, that mcp.clickup.com resolves, and whether Franciszek's ClickUp token is still valid (re-run clickup-oauth-start if revoked). The 2026-07-01 incident was a transient connection failure of exactly this kind that the old well-known ping could not see.

value.message: Sonda ClickUp MCP nie powiodla sie — hostowany serwer MCP nie polaczyl sie w realnej sesji (narzedzia ClickUp niedostepne dla agentow).
value.details: =Blad: {{ (($json.error || {}).message) || $json.error || JSON.stringify($json).slice(0,400) }}. Gdy ClickUp MCP nie laczy sie, wszystkie tiery traca zakresowane wyszukiwanie/odczyt ClickUp (discovery + dokumenty), a wynik cichego biegu jest gorszy lub pusty. Sprawdz status.clickup.com, rozwiazywanie mcp.clickup.com oraz waznosc tokenu ClickUp Franciszka (clickup-oauth-start jesli odwolany).
